title: ModelAngelo: automated atomic model building in cryo-EM maps
summary: ModelAngelo combines cryo-EM density, protein sequence and local geometry to build atomic models. Beyond method benchmarks, the paper identifies six previously unassigned proteins in a photosynthetic supercomplex and four additional radial-spoke proteins plus two central-apparatus proteins in Chlamydomonas reinhardtii. These assignments use existing experimental cryo-EM maps and sequence searches; the paper leaves the newly assigned ciliary proteins' functional roles for further investigation.
ai_technology: ModelAngelo graph neural network with hidden Markov model sequence search
organization: MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology (Scheres group)

evidence.tested: Models built by ModelAngelo were compared with those of human experts, and its protein identification was compared with human experts on proteins of unknown sequence.
evidence.unknown: Not reported in the abstract read; the nucleotide result is limited to backbone accuracy.
evidence.ai_role: A graph neural network combining cryo-EM density, protein sequence and local geometry to build atomic models and identify proteins.
